scripts.build: npm run build -w @training/shared && npm run build -w @training/api && npm run build -w @training/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @training/shared && npm run typecheck -w @training/shared && npm run typecheck -w @training/api && npm run typecheck -w @training/web
scripts.test: npm run build -w @training/shared && npm run test -w @training/api
scripts.test:e2e: npm run build && npm run test:e2e -w @training/web
scripts.test:db: npm run build -w @training/shared && npm run test:db -w @training/api
scripts.db:seed: npm run build -w @training/shared && npm run db:seed -w @training/api
